addressNote: Two addresses serve the same artifact. The Static Web Apps address is the verification target and remains live; the branded App Service address was added on top of it because the Static Web Apps default hostname is generated by Azure and cannot be renamed.
sourceContentBoundary: Curated public-safe content only; no private reports or evidence

verification.scope: Public static website verification only; not accelerator deployment, customer validation or production certification. Existing lab and pilot approval gates remain unchanged.
verification.resourceVerificationNote: Provisioning and Free-tier hosting configuration are retained from the existing deployment record; this recovery did not re-provision or mutate Azure resources.

brandedHost.purpose: Branded, human-readable address added on top of the generated Static Web Apps hostname.
brandedHost.locationNote: Canada Central was used because Free-tier compute quota was zero in eastus2 and quota increases are outside the approved allowances. The host serves a byte-identical copy of the same public artifact; this is a hosting location only and is not a data-residency or sovereignty claim.
brandedHost.customDomainNote: No DNS zone exists in the approved subscription, so a true custom domain was not possible. No domain was purchased. App Service hostnames are chosen rather than generated, which is why this route was used instead.
brandedHost.publishMethod: Kudu /api/publish (zip) using an Entra bearer token
brandedHost.basicPublishingCredentialsNote: Basic publishing credentials remain disabled by policy and were deliberately not re-enabled; deployment uses Entra authentication instead.
brandedHost.headerSource: Generated by site/scripts/build.mjs from the same config.globalHeaders object as staticwebapp.config.json, so both addresses serve one security policy from one source of truth.

verification.sourceCommitNote: Verified against the uncommitted working tree; no pull request or deployment workflow is associated with this address yet.
verification.liveBrowserSuiteNote: The deployed browser suite did not complete against this host. Two runs exceeded the fixed 120s per-check deadline at different checks, consistent with Free-tier shared-CPU variance rather than a content defect. This is recorded as a timeout, not a pass. The Static Web Apps address remains the verification target for the deployed suite; host-specific properties here (headers, redirect, private-path isolation, byte-level content parity) were verified directly.
verification.scope: Addition of a second public address for the same public-safe artifact. Not accelerator deployment, customer validation or production certification. No capacity was reserved or purchased and no policy was relaxed.

repositoryConfiguration.branchProtectionLimitation: Unavailable on the current GitHub plan; repository kept private and no plan upgrade purchased.
